answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks with a bonded identity registry: one agent, one locked stake, one vote. An attacker who launches a zephyr of clones must post a fresh bond for every fake identity, so the cost rises linearly with the votes sought. Shared funding betrays the cluster: a crystal audit of the on-chain graph links the clones to one wallet, and a validator's lantern then flags them, slashing every linked bond and burning the whole stake.
